def: Open-source C/C++ inference engine built on the ggml tensor library that runs GGUF models, usually quantized, on CPUs, Apple silicon and a wide range of GPUs.
practice: The engine under many local tools; it supports 1.5- to 8-bit integer quantization, splits models larger than VRAM between CPU and GPU, and ships an OpenAI-compatible server, llama-server.
